outputs.description: Acoustic temperature parameters B11 and B33 for constant E and constant P.

Total average temperature parameters. The checker verifies that final B11 = acoustic B11 + optic B11 and final B33 = acoustic B33, then compares the four totals to hidden paper‑reported gold within an absolute tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The checker first validates self‑consistency (final = acoustic + optic) and then scores the final totals. Only the final totals carry explicit score weight.
